newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - Enso 8-mth profit seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Enso 8-mth profit seen down.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 1.17 billion markka median forecast for forestry group Enso Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 22.

In January-August 1995, Enso's and Veitsiluoto's combined proforma profit after financial items was 2.68 billion markka. Its January-April profit after financial items was 801 million markka and its full-year 1995 profit was 3.52 billion markka.
Enso was formed through the merger of forestry groups Enso-Gutzeit Oy and Veitsiluoto Oy on May 1.
The company said on June 18 shutdowns would dent its second tertial financial performance, but the final tertial would show an improvement.
For Enso's full-year 1996 profit, eight of the 12 analysts polled gave a median forecast profit after financial items of 1.80 billion markka (mean 1.72 billion) in a 1.31-2.12 billion markka range.
The data was collected in the first two weeks of October.
Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FSB Securities, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita and Opstock.
